title: Ministers of the New Covenant

questions.question: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, as some do, letters of ____ to you, or from you?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:1 (ESV): "Are we beginning to commend ourselves again? Or do we need, as some do, letters of recommendation to you, or from you?"

questions.question: Paul says, "You yourselves are our letter of recommendation, written on our ____, to be known and read by all."
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:2 (ESV): "You yourselves are our letter of recommendation, written on our hearts, to be known and read by all."

questions.question: They are a letter from Christ delivered by Paul, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:3 (ESV): "And you show that you are a letter from Christ delivered by us, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts."

questions.question: Paul states that we are not sufficient in ourselves to claim anything as coming from us, but our sufficiency is from ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:5 (ESV): "Not that we are sufficient in ourselves to claim anything as coming from us, but our sufficiency is from God,"

questions.question: God has made us sufficient to be ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter ____, but the Spirit gives life.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:6 (ESV): "who has made us sufficient to be ministers of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life."

questions.question: If the ministry of death, carved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at ____ face...
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:7 (ESV): "Now if the ministry of death, carved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at Moses' face because of its glory, which was being brought to an end,"

questions.question: Will not the ministry of the ____ have even more glory?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:8 (ESV): "will not the ministry of the Spirit have even more glory?"

questions.question: For if there was glory in the ministry of condemnation, the ministry of ____ must far exceed it in glory.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:9 (ESV): "For if there was glory in the ministry of condemnation, the ministry of righteousness must far exceed it in glory."

questions.question: Since we have such a hope, we are very ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:12 (ESV): "Since we have such a hope, we are very bold,"

questions.question: We are not like Moses, who would put a ____ over his face so that the Israelites might not gaze at the outcome of what was being brought to an end.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:13 (ESV): "not like Moses, who would put a veil over his face so that the Israelites might not gaze at the outcome of what was being brought to an end."

questions.question: But their minds were hardened. For to this day, when they read the old covenant, that same ____ remains unlifted.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:14 (ESV): "But their minds were hardened. For to this day, when they read the old covenant, that same veil remains unlifted, because only through Christ is it taken away."

questions.question: Only through who is the veil taken away?
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:14 (ESV): "...because only through Christ is it taken away."

questions.question: But when one ____, the veil is removed.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:16 (ESV): "But when one turns to the Lord, the veil is removed."

questions.question: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:17 (ESV): "Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom."

questions.question: And we all, with unveiled face, beholding the glory of the Lord, are being ____ into the same image from one degree of glory to another.
questions.explanation: 2 Corinthians 3:18 (ESV): "And we all, with unveiled face, beholding the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from one degree of glory to another. For this comes from the Lord who is the Spirit."

key_verse_text: Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom. And we all, with unveiled face, beholding the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into the same image from one degree of glory to another. For this comes from the Lord who is the Spirit.
